name: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Classic 3x3 grid. Two players alternate placing their mark (X or O) on an empty cell.
objective: Get three of your marks in a row, column, or diagonal before your opponent does.
rules: A cell may be claimed only once.
The board is a 9-cell list, indexed 0-8, row-major (0-2 top row, 3-5 middle, 6-8 bottom).
win_conditions: You have three of your marks in a row, column, or diagonal.
lose_conditions: Your opponent has three of their marks in a row, column, or diagonal.

actions.name: place_mark
actions.description: Place your mark on an empty cell. Cells are indexed 0-8 (row-major).
